```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(DT)
library(MARSS)
```

```{r load-data}
res <- readRDS(here("results", "adjusted_model_fits.rds"))

ratio_unpooled_list <- res$ratio_unpooled_list
pooled_fit          <- res$pooled_fit
my_states           <- res$my_states
sigma.vec           <- res$sigma.vec
```

```{r}
ratio_unpooled_list
```
```{r build-table-function}
build_sd_table_adjusted <- function(fit_list, sigma.vec, my_states) {
  # Extract parameters from a list of single-state marss_fit_for_pooled fits
  # Model has persistent (q_p = ratio^2 * q) and transitory (q_t = q) components
  # plus known sampling variance R = sigma^2
  #
  # Columns match table-1-sds: drift, process_SD, observation_SD, sampling_SD, shock_SD
  #   drift          = U (drift on persistent component)
  #   process_SD     = sqrt(q_p)  (persistent innovation SD)
  #   observation_SD = sqrt(q_t + sigma^2)  (total obs-level SD: transitory + sampling)
  #   sampling_SD    = sigma (known)
  #   shock_SD       = sqrt(q_t)  (transitory shock SD)

  n <- length(fit_list)
  out <- data.frame(
    drift          = numeric(n),
    process_SD     = numeric(n),
    observation_SD = numeric(n),
    sampling_SD    = numeric(n),
    shock_SD       = numeric(n),
    row.names      = my_states
  )

  for (i in 1:n) {
    fit <- fit_list[[i]]
    q_val <- coef(fit)$Q["q", ]
    q_p <- 9 * q_val   # persistent variance (ratio=3, so 3^2=9)
    q_t <- q_val        # transitory variance
    d <- coef(fit)$U[1, 1]
    samp_var <- as.numeric(sigma.vec[i])^2

    out$drift[i]          <- d
    out$process_SD[i]     <- sqrt(q_p)
    out$observation_SD[i] <- sqrt(q_t + samp_var)
    out$sampling_SD[i]    <- as.numeric(sigma.vec[i])
    out$shock_SD[i]       <- sqrt(q_t)
  }

  out
}

build_sd_table_pooled <- function(pooled_fit, sigma.vec, my_states) {
  # Extract parameters from a pooled marss_fit_for_pooled fit
  # Q is shared across states; U varies by state

  n <- length(my_states)
  q_val <- pooled_fit$par$Q["q", ]
  q_p <- 9 * q_val
  q_t <- q_val

  out <- data.frame(
    drift          = numeric(n),
    process_SD     = numeric(n),
    observation_SD = numeric(n),
    sampling_SD    = numeric(n),
    shock_SD       = numeric(n),
    row.names      = my_states
  )

  for (i in 1:n) {
    d <- coef(pooled_fit)$U[i, 1]
    samp_var <- as.numeric(sigma.vec[i])^2

    out$drift[i]          <- d
    out$process_SD[i]     <- sqrt(q_p)
    out$observation_SD[i] <- sqrt(q_t + samp_var)
    out$sampling_SD[i]    <- as.numeric(sigma.vec[i])
    out$shock_SD[i]       <- sqrt(q_t)
  }

  out
}
```

## Ratio-Unpooled (SD Ratio = 3)

```{r table-ratio-unpooled}
tbl_ratio <- build_sd_table_adjusted(ratio_unpooled_list, sigma.vec, my_states)

DT::datatable(
  round(tbl_ratio, 8),
  caption  = "Ratio-unpooled parameter estimates (SD scale, ratio = 3)",
  options  = list(pageLength = 50, scrollX = TRUE),
  rownames = TRUE
)
```

## Pooled (SD Ratio = 3)

```{r table-pooled}
tbl_pooled <- build_sd_table_pooled(pooled_fit, sigma.vec, my_states)

DT::datatable(
  round(tbl_pooled, 8),
  caption  = "Pooled parameter estimates (SD scale, ratio = 3)",
  options  = list(pageLength = 50, scrollX = TRUE),
  rownames = TRUE
)
```

## AIC Comparison

```{r aic-comparison}
aic_unpooled_by_state <- sapply(ratio_unpooled_list, function(f) f$AIC)
aic_unpooled_total    <- sum(aic_unpooled_by_state)
aic_pooled            <- pooled_fit$AIC

data.frame(
  model = c("ratio_unpooled (sum across states)", "pooled"),
  AIC   = c(aic_unpooled_total, aic_pooled),
  delta = c(aic_unpooled_total - aic_pooled, 0)
)
```

## Pooled — LaTeX

```{r latex-pooled, results='asis'}
tbl_latex <- round(tbl_pooled, 3)

# Move USA row to bottom, rename to US
us_idx <- which(rownames(tbl_latex) == "USA")
if (length(us_idx)) {
  rownames(tbl_latex)[us_idx] <- "US"
  tbl_latex <- rbind(tbl_latex[-us_idx, , drop = FALSE], tbl_latex[us_idx, , drop = FALSE])
}

# Map state abbreviations to full names (keep DC and US as-is)
abb_to_name <- setNames(state.name, state.abb)
abb_to_name["US"] <- "US"
rn <- rownames(tbl_latex)
mapped <- abb_to_name[rn]
rownames(tbl_latex) <- ifelse(is.na(mapped), rn, mapped)

# Replace 0 and NA with "ND"
tbl_char <- as.data.frame(lapply(tbl_latex, function(col) {
  s <- ifelse(is.na(col) | col == 0, "ND", format(col, nsmall = 3))
  s
}), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(tbl_char) <- rownames(tbl_latex)

# Build LaTeX
header <- paste0(
  "\\begin{table}[ht]\n",
  "\\centering\n",
  "\\caption{Pooled parameter estimates (SD scale, ratio = 3)}\n",
  "\\begin{tabular}{l", paste(rep("r", ncol(tbl_char)), collapse = ""), "}\n",
  "\\hline\n",
  "State & ", paste(c("Drift", "Process SD", "Observation SD", "Sampling SD", "Shock SD"), collapse = " & "), " \\\\\n",
  "\\hline\n"
)

body <- paste(apply(cbind(rownames(tbl_char), tbl_char), 1, function(r) {
  paste(r, collapse = " & ")
}), collapse = " \\\\\n")

footer <- paste0(
  " \\\\\n\\hline\n",
  "\\end{tabular}\n",
  "\\end{table}"
)

cat("```latex\n")
cat(header, body, footer, sep = "")
cat("\n```\n")
```
